title.target: If I were you, I'd have...

objective: Al terminar combinas condicionales de distintos tiempos (mixtos), das consejos retrospectivos y hablas de consecuencias pasadas en el presente.

warmup.prompt_es: 'Si hubiera estudiado medicina, ahora sería médico.' Los condicionales mixtos unen un pasado imaginario con un presente imaginario (o al revés).

lines.speaker: Rita
lines.text: I keep thinking about my decision to leave university. If I had finished my degree, I would have a much better job now.
lines.es: No dejo de pensar en mi decisión de abandonar la universidad. Si hubiera terminado la carrera, ahora tendría un trabajo mucho mejor.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: If I were you, I wouldn't torture myself like that. You can still go back to study.
lines.es: Yo en tu lugar no me torturaría así. Todavía puedes volver a estudiar.

lines.speaker: Rita
lines.text: I suppose so. If I weren't so busy with work, I would have enrolled last year.
lines.es: Supongo. Si no estuviera tan ocupada con el trabajo, me habría matriculado el año pasado.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Look, if you had listened to your parents, you'd be a lawyer by now. But would you be happy?
lines.es: Mira, si hubieras hecho caso a tus padres, ya serías abogada. ¿Pero serías feliz?

lines.speaker: Rita
lines.text: Probably not. If I were more patient, I might have stayed. But I'm not.
lines.es: Seguramente no. Si fuera más paciente, quizá me habría quedado. Pero no lo soy.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Then don't regret it. If I were in your position, I'd have done exactly the same thing.
lines.es: Entonces no te arrepientas. Si yo estuviera en tu lugar, habría hecho exactamente lo mismo.

lines.speaker: Rita
lines.text: Thanks, Sam. If it hadn't been for you, I'd still be doubting myself.
lines.es: Gracias, Sam. Si no hubiera sido por ti, aún estaría dudando de mí misma.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Anytime. And remember: you should have trusted yourself earlier, but it's not too late.
lines.es: Cuando quieras. Y recuerda: deberías haber confiado en ti antes, pero no es demasiado tarde.

glossary.example: By now I'd be a doctor.
If it hadn't been for you…

md_es: | **Pasado → presente** | *if + past perfect, would + verbo* | una causa pasada que no ocurrió afecta al presente | *If I **had studied** medicine, I **would be** a doctor now.* |
| **Presente → pasado** | *if + past simple, would have + participio* | una característica presente afecta a un hecho pasado | *If I **weren't** so shy, I **would have asked** her out.* |
- *If I were you, I'd have + participio* → *If I were you, I'd have told her the truth.* (Yo en tu lugar lo habría hecho.)
- *You should have + participio* → crítica o consejo tarde. *You shouldn't have + participio* → reproche.
- *You could have + participio* → había otra opción. *You might have + participio* → quizá lo hiciste (o reproche suave).
**If it hadn't been for…** (si no hubiera sido por):
- *If it hadn't been for your help, I wouldn't have passed.* → *But for your help, …* (formal).
- *If I were to win the lottery, I'd travel the world.* (hipótesis remota).
- ✘ *If I was you* (informal; en formal se prefiere *were*) → ✔ *If I were you.*
- ✘ *If I had studied, I would be a doctor now.* es correcta (mixto); ✘ *If I studied, I would have been a doctor.* → ✔ *If I had studied…*
- ✘ *If I would be taller, …* → ✔ *If I were taller, …*
**Ojo:** *were* para todas las personas en hipótesis (*If he were here…*); en habla coloquial verás *was*, pero en B2 usa *were* en escritura formal.
